root_causes: The Unlimited Chat setting was registered but never read by GuiNewChat; both history buffers were always trimmed to 100 lines.
Ordinary ChatComponentText messages were not added to chatLines, and other component types were inserted into drawnChatLines instead of the persistent history buffer.
Refreshing nonzero-ID messages removed entries from the history being iterated.
Client-marked wrapped messages reused the full original component for every rendered line.
behavior: With the Chat module and Unlimited Chat enabled, both original-message history and wrapped display lines can exceed 100 entries.
With either disabled, incoming messages trim both buffers to the newest 100 entries.
All component types are recorded once in original-message history; wrapped display lines retain client markers.
Refreshing chat rebuilds display lines without deleting original-message history; incoming nonzero IDs still replace previous messages.
scope: Client chat scrollback only. Outgoing message length, server restrictions and Clear Chat on Relog behavior are unchanged. Already discarded history cannot be recovered.

chat_coverage: Translated messages, wrapped client markers, refresh with nonzero IDs, replacement, deletion and clear

recovery_audit.meaning: Recovery audit only; does not assert successful source compilation or runtime equivalence of cleaned source
